skylasliver_expbook.configuration.title: Experience Book · Global Configuration
skylasliver_expbook.configuration.automa: Controls which automatic features are available to all books. Each feature must also be enabled in the individual book's settings.
Allow books to collect picked-up XP before vanilla Mending. Disabled by default in each book.
Allow stored XP to repair carried Mending items. Disabled by default in each book.
Allow stored XP to refill the player's level up to the target. Disabled by default in each book.
Target level for books without a saved target, capped by the maximum target level.
Highest target level that can be selected for each book.
skylasliver_expbook.configuration.pageCa: Capacity per page in raw XP points, not levels. Lowering capacity preserves stored XP; overfull books cannot store more.
XP point capacity provided by each Leather Page.
XP point capacity provided by each Gilded Page.
XP point capacity provided by each Gemstone Page.
XP point capacity provided by each Ancient Page.
XP point capacity provided by each Star-Infused Page.

gui.skylasliver_expbook.collect_help: Picked-up XP goes into this carried book first. Excess XP follows vanilla behavior.

gui.skylasliver_expbook.pump_help: After repairs each second, spend remaining stored XP to reach the target level, as far as available XP allows.

gui.skylasliver_expbook.admin.take_help: Deliver to the admin and erase the old book. Receiving does not bind it; first use does. Click again to confirm.
gui.skylasliver_expbook.admin.recover_he: Send a replacement to the previous owner and erase the old book. The new book binds on first use. Click again to confirm.
